headline: 古典與民謠專輯評論
context: 兩張專輯：馬勒（Mahler）青年歌曲集《Songs of Youth and Awakening》被讚熱情與強度兼具；Wild Gods 的《The Glorious Abysmal》從赫布里底群島的蓋爾語共唱傳統長出迷幻民謠。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Rennert/Konradi/Peter/Keenlyside/Middleton (Signum) This collection of songs that the composer wrote as a young man is full of interest and emotion. Pianist Joseph Middleton brings sensitive support and an array of illustrative colours The second volume in Signum’s survey of Mahler song focuses on the three books of Lieder und Gesänge that the composer worked on in his 20s, rounding off the album with his first vocal masterpiece, the Lieder eines fahrenden Gesellen. These early ditties are highly individual, often quirky and invariably full of interest. Joseph Middleton, whose instinctual pacing and sensitive support of the vocal line is matched by an array of illustrative colours drawn from the piano, has assembled a fine cast of singers. Sophie Rennert opens with Frühlingsmorgen, her full-bodied mezzo and expressive diction mining this lilting Viennese gem for textual nuance. She’s equally persuasive in Ich ging mit Lust durch einen grünen Wald, one of Mahler’s most luminous songs. Ablösung im Sommer, a bizarre celebration of a cuckoo that has fallen off its perch, is given a deliciously theatrical workout by Katharina Konradi. Continue reading...
sources.title: Mahler: Songs of Youth and Awakening album review – exuberance and intensity from fine cast of singers

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: (Wren Cathedral) Inspired by communal Hebridean Gaelic song and ceremonial music, these reels and ballads reveal the fascinating proximity of post-rock and folk rock A thick, distant rumble, the metallic sheen of an accordion drone and a woman singing a traditional Gaelic lament for the dead: these open Keening, the first track on the most fascinating folk-adjacent set of the summer. Wild Gods is a new project from Argyll’s Jamie Livingstone, a regular collaborator with the Scottish electronic producer Barry Can’t Swim. This release is inspired by the waulking songs of the Hebrides: communal songs traditionally sung by women as they beat and softened tweed before mechanisation transformed the industry’s rhythms. With Gaelic archival recordings and melodies rooted in Celtic ceremonial music also being stirred into this bubbling brew, these eight tracks reveal the occasional, fascinating proximity between post-rock and folk-rock. After Keening, 10-minute Carlene’s Pin marries Susannah Stark’s gorgeous Gaelic vocals to clanging Bad Seeds guitars, folk fiddle, and a bassline recalling Godspeed You! Black Emperor at their most defiantly uncheery. Rest and Be Thankful, named after both a classic Scottish reel and a famous A83 viewpoint where couples are known to meet to have sex, is deliberately built up as a tender ballad, before moments of joyous folk dance strut and erupt; a shimmering interlude follows. Ortha, named after a Celtic incantation, reflects another of Livingstone’s inspirations: a transformative ayahuasca experience. Continue reading...
sources.title: Wild Gods: The Glorious Abysmal review – truly fascinating songs born of tweed-beating and psychedelic trips

thread_text:
專輯兩張。Signum 的馬勒（Mahler）歌曲系列第二輯《Songs of Youth and Awakening》聚焦作曲家年輕時的歌曲，演唱陣容出色，鋼琴家 Joseph Middleton 的伴奏色彩豐富。Wild Gods 的《The Glorious Abysmal》則從赫布里底群島的蓋爾語共唱與儀式音樂長出來——評論說這些歌「誕生於捶打粗花呢與迷幻旅程」，揭示後搖滾與民謠搖滾的親緣。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 10 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
兩張很不一樣的專輯。古典這邊，Signum 的馬勒（Mahler）歌曲系列出到第二輯《Songs of Youth and Awakening》，聚焦馬勒年輕時寫的歌，評論稱演唱陣容熱情與強度兼具，鋼琴家 Joseph Middleton 給出細膩支撐和一整排的色彩。另一張是 Wild Gods 的《The Glorious Abysmal》：從赫布里底群島的蓋爾語共唱和儀式音樂長出來的捲軸舞曲與敘事歌——遠處厚重的隆隆聲、手風琴的金屬光澤、一位女聲唱著悼亡的蓋爾語輓歌。評論說，這些歌揭示了後搖滾與民謠搖滾其實靠得很近。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 10 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 兩張很不一樣的專輯。古典這邊，馬勒歌曲系列的第二輯，聚焦他年輕時寫的歌，評論說演唱陣容熱情與強度兼具。另一張來自 Wild Gods，從蘇格蘭赫布里底群島的蓋爾語共唱傳統長出來——遠處的隆隆聲、手風琴的金屬光澤、一位女聲唱著悼亡輓歌。評論的結論是：後搖滾和民謠，其實靠得很近。
